mapper.sql: CASE WHEN config->>'content_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'full_new_items' THEN 'disabled' WHEN rss_baselined_at IS NULL THEN 'pending' ELSE 'active' END
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS source_id, rss_generation AS activation_generation, AS activation_state, rss_baselined_at AS activation_at, (SELECT count(*)::int FROM rss_full_content_entries e WHERE e.source_id=s.id AND e.activation_generation=s.rss_generation AND e.entry_kind='baseline') AS baseline_count, (SELECT max(observed_at) FROM rss_full_content_entries e WHERE e.source_id=s.id AND e.activation_generation=s.rss_generation) AS last_discovery_at FROM sources s WHERE s.id=#{sourceId} AND s.kind='rss'
SELECT config::text FROM sources WHERE id = #{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT AS activation_state, rss_generation AS activation_generation FROM sources WHERE id=#{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rss_full_content_entries(id,source_id,activation_generation,external_key,title,entry_kind) VALUES(#{id},#{sourceId},#{generation},#{externalKey},#{title},'baseline') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE sources SET rss_baselined_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{sourceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rss_full_content_entries (id,source_id,activation_generation,external_key,title,article_url,summary,embedded_html,doc_time,entry_kind,observed_at) VALUES(#{id},#{sourceId},#{generation},#{externalKey},#{title},#{articleUrl},#{summary},#{embeddedHtml},#{docTime},#{kind},#{observedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE rss_full_content_entries e SET current_job_id=NULL WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND activation_generation=#{generation} AND external_key=#{externalKey} AND entry_kind<>'baseline' AND observed_at<=#{observedAt} AND #{hasUsableSource} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_deletions dd JOIN documents d ON d.id=dd.document_id WHERE d.source_id=e.source_id AND dd.external_key=e.external_key AND GREATEST(dd.created_at,d.purged_at)>=COALESCE( (SELECT (payload->>'observed_at')::timestamptz FROM jobs WHERE id=e.current_job_id),e.observed_at))

UPDATE rss_full_content_entries SET title=#{title}, article_url=#{articleUrl}, summary=#{summary}, embedded_html=#{embeddedHtml}, doc_time=#{docTime}, observed_at=#{observedAt}, updated_at=clock_timestamp(), entry_kind=CASE WHEN #{hasUsableSource} THEN 'candidate' ELSE entry_kind END WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND activation_generation=#{generation} AND external_key=#{externalKey} AND entry_kind<>'baseline' AND observed_at<=#{observedAt} AND (#{hasUsableSource} OR entry_kind='no_source') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jobs WHERE id=current_job_id AND status='done')
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM rss_full_content_entries e JOIN jobs j ON j.id=e.current_job_id WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND activation_generation=#{generation} AND j.status IN ('queued','running')

SELECT id,observed_at FROM rss_full_content_entries e WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND activation_generation=#{generation} AND entry_kind='candidate' AND current_job_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_deletions dd JOIN documents d ON d.id=dd.document_id WHERE d.source_id=e.source_id AND dd.external_key=e.external_key AND GREATEST(dd.created_at,d.purged_at)>=e.observed_at) ORDER BY first_seen_at,id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT e.id, e.source_id, e.activation_generation, e.external_key, e.title, e.article_url, e.summary, e.embedded_html, e.doc_time, CASE WHEN s.rss_generation <> e.activation_generation OR s.config->>'content_mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'full_new_items' THEN 'superseded' WHEN e.entry_kind='baseline' THEN 'baseline' WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL THEN 'complete' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_deletions dd JOIN documents old ON old.id=dd.document_id WHERE old.source_id=e.source_id AND dd.external_key=e.external_key AND GREATEST(dd.created_at,old.purged_at)>=COALESCE((j.payload->>'observed_at')::timestamptz,e.observed_at)) THEN 'deleted' WHEN e.entry_kind='no_source' THEN 'terminal' WHEN j.status='running' THEN 'hydrating' WHEN j.status='queued' AND j.attempts>0 THEN 'retry_wait' WHEN j.status='queued' THEN 'queued' WHEN j.status='failed' THEN 'terminal' WHEN j.status='done' THEN 'superseded' ELSE 'pending' END AS state, e.current_job_id AS hydration_job_id, COALESCE(j.attempts,0) AS attempt_count, d.id AS document_id, CASE WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.entry_kind='no_source' THEN 'no_usable_content_source' WHEN j.status='failed' THEN 'acquisition_failed' END AS error_code, CASE WHEN d.id IS NOT NULL AND d.deleted_at IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN e.entry_kind='no_source' THEN 'No usable content source was observed' WHEN j.status='failed' THEN 'Full-content acquisition failed; retry is available' END AS error_detail, e.first_seen_at, GREATEST(e.updated_at,j.updated_at,d.updated_at) AS updated_at, CASE WHEN j.status='done' AND d.deleted_at IS NULL THEN j.updated_at END AS completed_at FROM rss_full_content_entries e JOIN sources s ON s.id=e.source_id LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id=e.current_job_id LEFT JOIN documents d ON d.source_id=e.source_id AND d.external_key=e.external_key AND d.purged_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT j.attempts FROM rss_full_content_entries e JOIN jobs j ON j.id=e.current_job_id JOIN sources s ON s.id=e.source_id WHERE e.id=#{id} AND j.id=#{jobId} AND j.status='running' AND e.entry_kind='candidate' AND s.rss_generation=e.activation_generation AND s.rss_baselined_at IS NOT NULL AND s.config->>'content_mode'='full_new_items'

SELECT e.id FROM rss_full_content_entries e JOIN sources s ON s.id=e.source_id JOIN jobs j ON j.id=e.current_job_id WHERE e.id=#{id} AND j.id=#{jobId} AND e.source_id=#{sourceId} AND e.activation_generation=#{generation} AND e.external_key=#{externalKey} AND s.kb_id=#{kbId} AND e.entry_kind='candidate' AND j.status='running' AND j.payload ?? 'observed_at' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM document_deletions dd JOIN documents d ON d.id=dd.document_id WHERE d.source_id=e.source_id AND dd.external_key=e.external_key AND GREATEST(dd.created_at,d.purged_at)>=(j.payload->>'observed_at')::timestamptz) FOR UPDATE OF e,j
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET status='done', last_error=NULL, updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{jobId}
mapper.select: WHERE e.source_id=#{sourceId} AND e.activation_generation=s.rss_generation ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH projected AS () SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='pending') AS pending_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='queued') AS queued_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='hydrating') AS hydrating_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='retry_wait') AS retrying_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='complete') AS complete_count, count(*) FILTER(WHERE state IN ('terminal','deleted','superseded')) AS terminal_count FROM projected WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND activation_generation=#{generation}

SELECT DISTINCT e.source_id FROM rss_full_content_entries e JOIN jobs j ON j.id = e.current_job_id JOIN sources s ON s.id = e.source_id WHERE j.status = 'failed' AND j.kind = 'hydrate_rss_entry' AND (#{kbId}::uuid IS NULL OR s.kb_id = #{kbId}) AND (#{failedSince}::timestamptz IS NULL OR j.updated_at >= #{failedSince}) ORDER BY e.source_id
SELECT id FROM sources WHERE id = #{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT rss_generation FROM sources WHERE id=#{sourceId} AND rss_baselined_at IS NOT NULL AND config->>'content_mode'='full_new_items'

SELECT count(*) FROM rss_full_content_entries e JOIN jobs j ON j.id = e.current_job_id WHERE e.source_id = #{sourceId} AND e.activation_generation = #{generation} AND j.status IN ('queued', 'running')

SELECT j.id FROM rss_full_content_entries e JOIN jobs j ON j.id = e.current_job_id WHERE e.source_id = #{sourceId} AND e.activation_generation = #{generation} AND j.kind = 'hydrate_rss_entry' AND j.status = 'failed' AND (#{failedSince}::timestamptz IS NULL OR j.updated_at >= #{failedSince}) AND j.payload ?? 'observed_at' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM document_deletions dd JOIN documents d ON d.id = dd.document_id WHERE d.source_id = e.source_id AND dd.external_key = e.external_key AND GREATEST(dd.created_at, d.purged_at) >= (j.payload->>'observed_at')::timestamptz) ORDER BY j.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF e, j
mapper.update: UPDATE jobs SET status = 'queued', attempts = 0, last_error = NULL, locked_at = NULL, run_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY(#{ids,typeHandler=tech.seexun.jknow.store.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler}::bigint[]) AND status = 'failed'
